abstract.p: The present disclosure relates to a specific dibenzoazepine compound for use in inhibiting or treating an infection of a subject with a pathogen that interacts with a complement receptor 3 (CR3) polypeptide-expressing cell, wherein the pathogen is selected from a Neisseria species and a retrovirus.
